reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Air-Fit Suncream Plus 50mL
reviews.text: This sunscreen works well as a light base makeup product too. It helps even out my skin tone slightly while providing sun protection, so I can use it almost like a lightweight foundation on casual days. The texture feels comfortable and natural on the skin
reviews.zh: 呢隻防曬當成輕薄底妝產品用都好啱。佢可以幫助輕微均勻膚色之餘又有防曬效果，所以 casual 嘅日子幾乎可以當輕薄粉底咁用。質感貼膚又自然。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Air-Fit Suncream Plus 50mL
reviews.text: I just started using this product. It glides on so silky smooth and not heavy as I am using layering with Rejuran Cream, Mary and May Eye Cream and my mineral tinted moisturizer for light coverage. I am totally happy so far! It is not pore clogging
reviews.zh: 啱啱開始用呢款產品。質感絲滑貼服又唔厚重，我會配合 Rejuran Cream、Mary and May Eye Cream 同礦物潤色保濕霜一齊用嚟做輕薄底妝。到目前為止好滿意！唔會堵塞毛孔。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Air-Fit Suncream Plus 50mL
reviews.text: i like this sunscreen. i tried it since it’s a physical sunscreen and i typically only like physical sunscreen because it doesn’t irritate my face. it doesn’t feel sticky. it applies nicely since physical sunscreens are usually thicker than chemical ones.
reviews.zh: 我鍾意呢隻防曬。試用係因為佢係物理防曬，而我一般只鍾意物理防曬，因為唔會刺激到我塊面。質感唔會黏笠。雖然物理防曬通常比化學防曬厚身，但呢隻搽上皮膚好貼服。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Air-Fit Suncream Plus 50mL
reviews.text: I was looking for a good physical/mineral sunscreen and was told this was one of the best korean ones. Haven't tried yet, can't wait to use after my current sunscreen runs out
reviews.zh: 我喺度搵一隻好嘅物理／礦物防曬，聽人講呢隻係韓國防曬入面數一數二嘅一款。仲未試過，好期待用完手上呢隻防曬之後用佢。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Air-Fit Suncream Plus 50mL
reviews.text: Hydratation, and good coverage. It has a bit of color in it which blends perfectly. Perfect for days when you don't feel like applying make-up. Definitely, my favorite among the Skin1004 sun care line.
reviews.zh: 保濕力好，遮瑕度亦唔錯。帶少少潤色，搽上皮膚好貼。完全唔想化妝嘅日子就啱晒。絕對係 Skin1004 防曬系列入面我最鍾意嘅一款。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Air-Fit Suncream Plus 50mL
reviews.text: Ok, this sunscreen isn't bad! The smell I was not anticipating, not a bad one thankfully haha, nor how long it will linger (about 5ish minutes from that I can estimate, I'll have to actually time it at some point...) but it is a clean smell so I'm not bothered by it when it's worn. The texture of the formula is smooth and I noticed that it dries kind of quick so if it is left to sit for a moment it will kind of...I don't know if pulling is the best description? Its not sticky by any means but it feels like I have to spray a mist of water to reactivate it. Absorption is great, the sensation of the sun intensity is reduced for me (while keeping up with reapplication!). Overall not my all time favorite but it is a good one to have on hand.
reviews.zh: 呢款防曬都唔差！個氣味我之前冇預到，慶幸係唔難聞嘅哈哈哈，亦冇預到會keep到咁耐（我估大概5分鐘左右，到時要真正計下時間……）但係個味道好clean，所以用住都唔會覺得唔舒服。質地好滑，我留意到佢乾得幾快，如果放住一陣先搽，會好似……唔知用「扯住」嚟形容啱唔啱？絕對唔會話黏笠，但感覺就要噴一噴水霧去reactivate。吸收力好好，曬嘅感覺冇咁強（記得要補搽！）。整體唔係我最愛，但係keep住一支係屋企都幾好。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Air-Fit Suncream Plus 50mL
reviews.text: I had a high hope on this one when purchasing it. But after application, I have realized that this tinted makes my skin look dull and doesn’t match my skin tone. So it was off my my skincare products.
reviews.zh: 買嘅時候對佢期望好高。但搽完之後，發現呢款tinted令我塊面望落好暗沉，又唔夾我膚色。所以已經剔出我嘅護膚品行列。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Air-Fit Suncream Plus 50mL
reviews.text: Repeated purchase. I can only use physical sunscreen. This is one of my favorite, it is creamy and easy to blend. I am pretty fair hence I have no issue with white cast. It leaves a radiant satin finish. Love it 😍
reviews.zh: 回購品。我只能用物理防曬。呢款係我至愛之一，質地creamy，好容易推開。我膚色偏白，所以泛白對我冇影響。完妝係亮澤嘅satin妝效。好鍾意 😍

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
